title: Auto Splash Refill
description: Auto refill splash potions in your hand from inventory
body:
**🧪 AutoSplashRefill — Automatic Potion Refill**

Tired of running out of splash potions mid-fight? This mod keeps you stocked automatically.

**AutoSplashRefill** automatically refills your hand with the same splash potion from your inventory right after you throw one.

### ✨ Features:

* 🔄 Automatically replaces thrown splash potions
* ⚡ Toggle on/off with a keybind
* 📊 Shows how many potions are left in your inventory
* 🪶 Lightweight and performance-friendly

### 🎯 Why use it:

* Perfect for PvP — no need to open inventory mid-fight
* Never run out of potions unexpectedly
* Faster and smoother gameplay

### 🛠️ Compatibility:

* Works on Fabric
* Supported Minecraft version: **1.21.4**

### 📌 Usage:

```
[Keybind] — toggle AutoSplashRefill on/off (Settings -> Controls -> Auto Splash Refill) 
Throw a splash potion — it will be automatically replaced if available  
The mod displays remaining potion count in your inventory
```
